title.narrative: Activity under preparation Syria: Reintegration and Resilience Support for Al-Hol and Roj

description.narrative: This Action, funded by the Service for Foreign Policy Instruments (FPI), fills critical gaps left by the reduction of United States support and is designed to complement the interventions of other donors such as the German Federal Foreign Office (GFFO), the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs (DMFA), and the French Ministry of European and Foreign Affairs (MEFA). While these donors currently support camp infrastructure, case management and social cohesion within Al-Hol and Roj Camps, FPI resources will focus on enabling the voluntary and dignified return of Syrian internally displaced persons (IDPs) and Iraqi households from these camps to their communities of origin and areas of return, beginning in Raqqa and Deir ez-Zor and expanding later to other locations identified with the authorities. FPI support will also pilot community centres in these areas of return and strengthen reintegration through case management, psychosocial support, and economic initiatives. By concentrating on areas that are not addressed by other partners, FPI provides a targeted contribution that strengthens the overall ecosystem of assistance. The Action will establish a transparent and dignified return process, increase resilience and stability in host communities, and promote social cohesion that reduces tensions and mitigates the risks of radicalization. In doing so, FPI will play a central role in linking immediate humanitarian support with longer-term recovery and stabilization in Syria.
